display.purpose: Page titles — Bricolage Grotesque 700, balanced wrapping.

body.purpose: Inter 400 for prose and data; muted slate reserved for metadata.

shadows.name: life-glow
shadows.purpose: Living/celebrated elements only (logo badge, active markers). Never ambient decoration.

motion.name: slow
motion.purpose: Sheets, panels. All animation gets a prefers-reduced-motion instant alternative.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main action — Living Green gradient for celebratory actions (redeem, adopt).
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #34D87A, #1F9D5C); color: #0B1D1A; font-family: 'Bricolage Grotesque', Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; padding: 10px 18px; min-height: 40px; border: none; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: filter 150ms ease, transform 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.1); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(52,216,122,0.35); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { background: #1F3B32; color: #94A3B8; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Nav Link
components.description: Header navigation — muted until hovered, then green wash.
components.css: .ds-nav-link { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 8px 14px; min-height: 40px; border-radius: 8px; color: #cbd5e1; font-family: 'Bricolage Grotesque', Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 150ms ease, color 150ms ease; } .ds-nav-link:hover, .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { background-color: rgba(110,231,160,0.1); color: #6EE7A0; }

components.name: Water-Status Badge
components.description: Signature status pill — colored border + text, always paired with a Romanian label.
components.html: Însetat
components.css: .ds-water-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; padding: 4px 10px; border: 1px solid #FBBF24; border-radius: 9999px; color: #FBBF24; background: transparent; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; }

components.name: Surface Card
components.description: Standard container — tonal surface, hairline border, ambient shadow.
components.html:
Augustul Udărilor

213 / 500 udări în Sectorul 5
components.css: .ds-card { background: #112220; border: 1px solid rgba(110,231,160,0.08); border-radius: 12px; padding: 14px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.05); } .ds-card-title { font-family: 'Bricolage Grotesque', Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; color: #f0fdf4; margin: 0 0 6px; } .ds-card-body { font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; color: #bbf7d0; margin: 0; }

components.name: Select Input
components.description: Form field — surface bg, green focus halo.
components.css: .ds-select { background-color: #112220; color: #f8fafc; border: 1px solid rgba(110,231,160,0.12); padding: 8px 14px; border-radius: 10px; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; outline: none; transition: border-color 150ms ease, box-shadow 150ms ease; } .ds-select:focus { border-color: #34D87A; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(52,216,122,0.15); }

components.name: Tree Message
components.description: Signature — first-person quote from a tree; the one sanctioned accent edge.
components.html: Mulțumesc pentru apă! Cresc frumos datorită ție. — Teiul Prosper
components.css: .ds-tree-message { display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: flex-start; margin: 0; padding: 8px 12px; border-left: 2px solid #34D87A; background: rgba(52,216,122,0.05); border-radius: 0 8px 8px 0; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-style: italic; color: #bbf7d0; }

narrative.overview: A city park after dark. The whole interface lives in deep forest darkness (Forest Night, #0B1D1A) and light appears only where life does: Living Green marks care, activity, and growth — a watered tree, an active guardian, a filling progress bar. The system is warm civic-tech: credible enough for a council chamber, human enough that a tree can say „mulțumesc
keyCharacteristics: One dark theme everywhere — no white surfaces, ever
Green is semantic: alive/active/cared-for, not decoration
Tonal depth, quiet shadows, glow reserved for living things
Mobile-first: one hand, bright sun, 44px targets

rules.name: The Living Green Rule
rules.body: Green always means something is alive, active, or cared-for. If an element is inert, it does not get green.

rules.name: The No-White Rule
rules.body: No white backgrounds anywhere — including modals, popups, and map popups. Every surface comes from the Forest Night ramp.

rules.name: The Two-Voices Rule
rules.body: Bricolage Grotesque speaks (headings, buttons, labels); Inter informs (body, data). Never introduce a third family.

rules.name: The Glow-Is-Earned Rule
rules.body: The green glow appears only on elements representing life or achievement — never as ambient decoration.

dos: Do keep every surface on the Forest Night ramp — dark modals, dark popups, dark map UI
Do pair every status color with a text label (legend, badge copy)
Do honor prefers-reduced-motion with instant/crossfade alternatives
Do keep body text ≥ #bbf7d0 contrast on surfaces (muted slate for metadata only)
donts: Don't build gray bureaucratic forms-and-tables screens (generic government portal)
Don't use stock leaf imagery or vague green gradients (corporate ESG greenwash)
Don't add mascots, confetti, or cartoon badges (childish gamification)
Don't put white backgrounds on any surface, including third-party widgets
Don't use glassmorphism beyond the sticky header, or glow on inert elements
Don't exceed two font families or use gradient text on new elements
